original_ai_output.title_zh: 联合国南苏丹特派团巡逻队抵达偏远伊巴社区，当地面临暴雨、不安全局势与健康威胁
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 联合国南苏丹特派团（UNMISS）一支巡逻队历经艰难抵达西赤道州伊巴县偏远社区，当地因暴雨、道路损毁及不安全局势而更加孤立。近期袭击、车辆伏击和绑架事件加剧了风险，据报有人员被绑架后至今未寻获。当地还担忧与刚果（金）接壤带来的埃博拉疫情威胁。

location.raw_text: Ibba County in Western Equatoria State, along the Yambio–Ibba road and Juba–Mundri–Yambio highway

key_facts.fact: 联合国南苏丹特派团巡逻队抵达西赤道州伊巴县偏远社区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a recent UNMISS patrol travelled day and night on a tortuous journey to conquer the hundred kilometers of the almost impassable road connecting Yambio to Ibba County

key_facts.fact: 暴雨和不安全局势使伊巴县社区更加孤立
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Heavy rains and insecurity have left communities in Ibba County in Western Equatoria State even more isolated than before

key_facts.fact: 近期袭击、车辆伏击和绑架事件加剧了车队风险
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Recent attacks, vehicle ambushes, and abductions amplified the risks to the convoy

key_facts.fact: 据伊巴县酋长称，5月有人员前往朱巴购货，返程途中被绑架，至今未寻获
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: In May, some of our sons travelled to Juba to buy goods. On their way back, they were abducted, and, to date, they have not been found

key_facts.fact: 当地担忧与刚果（金）接壤带来的埃博拉疫情威胁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On health, we are also concerned because we share a border with the Democratic Republic of Congo

uncertainties: 被绑架人员至今未寻获，其下落尚未确认
埃博拉疫情威胁为当地担忧，尚未证实当地出现病例
事件信息目前仅来自UNMISS单一来源，尚缺乏交叉验证
